thread.title: Your first trade for Thursday, Sept 6

author: Nia Warfield
title: Your first trade for Thursday, Sept 6
text:
The " Fast Money " traders shared their first moves for the market open.
Pete Najarian was a buyer of PayPal
Karen Finerman was a buyer of Target
Steve Grasso was a buyer of Twitter
Guy Adami was a buyer of Kroger
